Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the purchase or construction of public facilities in one hundred year floodplains.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the purchase or construction of publicfacilities in one hundred year floodplains; and adding a new section tochapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The purchase or construction of public facilities in a onehundred year floodplain may only be authorized through the followingactions by the applicable county or city legislative authority: Theadoption of findings declaring the need and reasoning for purchasing orconstructing the facility in a one hundred year floodplain; and anaffirmative vote authorizing the purchase or construction activity.For purposes of this section, "one hundred year floodplain" means thesame as "special flood hazard area" as set forth in WAC 173158040 asit exists on July 26, 2009. (2) This section applies to the purchase or construction of countyor city owned public facilities in counties and cities located west ofthe crest of the Cascade mountain range, but does not apply to: Roads, p. 1 SHB 2494streets, and other transportation facilities; public safety facilities;storm water facilities; flood control facilities; or undergroundconveyances.
